text: 财政部：一、营业总收入。1-9月，国有企业营业总收入600060.9亿元，同比下降3.2%。 二、利润总额。1-9月，国有企业利润总额33103.5亿元，同比增长3.0%。 三、应交税费。1-9月，国有企业应交税费46589.8亿元，同比增长4.7%。 四、资产负债率。9月末，国有企业资产负债率65.5%，同比上升0.4个百分点。
text_en: Ministry of Finance: I. Total operating revenue. From January to September, total operating revenue of state-owned enterprises was 60,006.09 billion yuan, down 3.2% year on year. II. Total profit. From January to September, total profit of state-owned enterprises was 3,310.35 billion yuan, up 3.0% year on year. III. Taxes payable. From January to September, taxes payable by state-owned enterprises were 4,658.98 billion yuan, up 4.7% year on year. IV. Asset-liability ratio. At the end of September, the asset-liability ratio of state-owned enterprises was 65.5%, up 0.4 percentage points year on year.
